question: Will FC Barcelona sign and register a new male first-team striker before the close of the 2026 summer transfer window?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if FC Barcelona officially announces the signing of a new male striker into the first team, AND that player is formally registered with LaLiga (i.e., the registration is confirmed and visible on LaLiga's official channels), both steps completed on or before the close of the 2026 LaLiga summer transfer window (September 1, 2026, 23:59 CEST / 21:59 UTC). The signing must be a new arrival (permanent transfer or loan) and not a promotion from an existing Barcelona youth/B-team squad without any external transfer.
- "No": Wins if FC Barcelona has not both officially announced and had formally confirmed by LaLiga any new male first-team striker arriving via an external transfer, with both steps completed on or before the close of the 2026 LaLiga summer transfer window (September 1, 2026, 23:59 CEST / 21:59 UTC).

Clarifications:
- "Striker" refers to a player whose primary listed position is centre-forward or striker (e.g., CF or ST); wingers or attacking midfielders signed primarily in those roles do not qualify.
- A player already on Barcelona's books (e.g., on loan recalled or promoted from Barça Atlètic) does not count as a new signing unless he was acquired via a new external transfer agreement completed during the 2026 summer window.
- Registration means the player has been formally listed as eligible to play for FC Barcelona's first team by LaLiga, as confirmed on LaLiga's official website or channels; a completed contract signing alone, without confirmed LaLiga registration, is insufficient for "Yes".
